name: Toughness (Solid White)
verdict: Two strip tests. First, centre 9.2 s (3.7-14.7 s): all bars formed but the surface stayed doughy; bars 1-4 curled after removal, 6-7 bent after ~20 min, and 3-8 flattened again on their own within an hour (not measured). Second, centre 12.4 s (5.0-19.8 s): dry surface with visible pixels; thickness by caliper #1 5.0 s 0.10 · #2 6.8 s 0.15 · #3 8.7 s 0.23 · #4 10.5 s 0.27 · #5 12.4 s 0.30 · #6 14.3 s 0.33 · #7 16.7 s 0.37 · #8 19.8 s 0.37 mm (flat from #7). #1-#2 curled, #3-#4 slightly wavy, #5-#8 straight; holes open on #3-#6, on #7 their lower half looks light in the photo and on #8 the first hole is smaller - whether they start to close is not checked. Picked #5, 12.4 s. White cures thicker than black at the same time (black 0.27 mm at 12.4 s).

tests.txt: Bars 5.0-19.8 s, after a first round centred on 9.2 s left a doughy surface. From 8.7 s the bars formed, thickness grew to 0.37 mm at 16.7 s and then stopped. Thin bars curl for a while after washing and flatten again as they dry. 12.4 s (0.30 mm) is the lowest bar with a dry surface and sharp pixels - deeper than the black bottle at the same time.
